    <linearGradient id="coreGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#00f260;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0575E6;stop-opacity:1" />

    <!-- Glow Filter -->
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#bgGradient)" />

  <!-- Main Group Centered -->

<svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Definitions: Gradients, Filters, Animations -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Core Glow Filter -->
    <filter id="coreGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>

    <!-- Connection Line Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="synapseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00ffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff00ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Node Radial Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="nodeGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#00ffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#004444" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <radialGradient id="nodeGradWarm" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ff00ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#440044" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Background Grid Pattern -->
    <pattern id="grid" width="40" height="40" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M 40 0 L 0 0 0 40" fill="none" stroke="#002222" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
    
    <!-- Pulse Animation for Nodes -->
    <animate id="pulseAnim" attributeName="r" values="6;10;6" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1; 0.4 0 0.6 1"/>
    <animate id="pulseOp" attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;1;0.6" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1; 0.4 0 0.6 1"/>
    
    <!-- Data Flow Animation for Lines -->
    <animate id="flowAnim" attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="100;0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#050510"/>
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#grid)"/>
  
  <!-- Subtle Vignette -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="200" rx="220" ry="220" fill="url(#vignette)" />
  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="60%" stop-color="transparent"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#050510"/>
  </radialGradient>

  <!-- LAYER 1: CONNECTIONS (Synapses) -->
  <g id="synapses" stroke="url(#synapseGrad)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#coreGlow)">
    <!-- We define paths manually for a "hand-wired" organic feel -->
    <!-- Cluster 1 (Top Left) -->
    <path d="M 80,80 Q 120,100 160,80" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 80,80 Q 100,130 100,180" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 160,80 Q 180,130 200,160" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    
    <!-- Cluster 2 (Center Core) -->
    <path d="M 200,160 Q 220,180 240,200" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 200,160 Q 180,190 160,220" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 240,200 Q 260,220 280,240" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 160,220 Q 140,250 140,280" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    
    <!-- Cross connections -->
    <path d="M 160,80 Q 200,120 200,160" stroke-dasharray="20 10" opacity="0.5"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 280,240 Q 260,280 220,300" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 140,280 Q 180,300 220,300" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    
    <!-- Cluster 3 (Bottom Right) -->
    <path d="M 280,240 Q 310,250 340,240" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 220,300 Q 260,320 300,340" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
    <path d="M 340,240 Q 360,280 340,320" stroke-dasharray="20 10"><use href="#flowAnim"/></path>
  </g>

  <!-- LAYER 2: NODES (Neurons) -->
  <g id="neurons" filter="url(#coreGlow)">
    <!-- Helper: Define a neuron group to reuse animations -->
    <!-- Type A: Cool (Cyan/Blue) - Logic/Processing -->
    <g class="neuron cool">
      <circle r="6" fill="url(#nodeGrad)">
        <animate href="#pulseAnim" begin="0s"/>
        <animate href="#pulseOp" begin="0s"/>
      </circle>
      <circle r="14" fill="none" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.3">
        <animate attributeName="r" values="14;22;14" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.5s"/>
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;0;0.3" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.5s"/>
      </circle>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Type B: Warm (Magenta/Pink) - Creativity/Generation -->
    <g class="neuron warm">
      <circle r="6" fill="url(#nodeGradWarm)">
        <animate href="#pulseAnim" begin="1.5s"/> <!-- Offset phase -->
        <animate href="#pulseOp" begin="1.5s"/>
      </circle>
      <circle r="14" fill="none" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.3">
        <animate attributeName="r" values="14;22;14" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2s"/>
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;0;0.3" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2s"/>
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- Placement: Input Layer (Top) -->
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="80" y="80"/>   <!-- x,y via transform -->
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="160" y="80"/>
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="240" y="100"/>
    
    <!-- Hidden Layer 1 -->
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="100" y="180"/>
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="200" y="160"/> <!-- Central Hub -->
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="280" y="200"/>
    
    <!-- Hidden Layer 2 -->
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="160" y="280"/>
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="240" y="260"/>
    
    <!-- Output Layer (Bottom) -->
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="140" y="340"/>
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="220" y="360"/>
    <use href="#neuron-cool" x="300" y="340"/>
    <use href="#neuron-warm" x="340" y="300"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Define the actual symbol instances for the <use> tags above -->
  <!-- We have to define symbols properly in defs or just use groups with transforms. 
       SVG <use> requires an ID on a <symbol> or <g> in <defs>. 
       Let's fix structure: Move neuron defs to <defs>. -->
</svg>

                <defs>

                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#0f172a;stop-opacity:1" />
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1e293b;stop-opacity:1" />
                    </linearGradient>
                    <linearGradient id="grad-body" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#334155;stop-opacity:1" />
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0f172a;stop-opacity:1" />
                    </linearGradient>
                    <linearGradient id="grad-accent" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#22d3ee;stop-opacity:1" />
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#3b82f6;stop-opacity:1" />
                    </linearGradient>
                    <radialGradient id="grad-glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#22d3ee;stop-opacity:0.4" />
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0f172a;stop-opacity:0" />
                    </radialGradient>
                    
                    <!-- Filters -->
                    <filter id="glow">
                        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5" result="coloredBlur"/>
                        <feMerge>
                            <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
                            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
                        </feMerge>
                    </filter>
                    <filter id="noise">
                        <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.65" numOctaves="3" stitchTiles="stitch"/>
                        <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/>
                    </filter>
                </defs>

                <!-- Background Glow -->
                <circle cx="250" cy="250" r="200" fill="url(#grad-glow)" />

                <!-- The "Head" / Core Processor -->
                <g id="core-head" transform="translate(250, 220)">

                    <path d="M-80,60 C-100,20 -90,-60 -40,-90 C0,-110 40,-110 80,-90 C130,-60 100,20 80,60 C60,100 -60,100 -80,60 Z" 
                          fill="url(#grad-body)" stroke="url(#grad-accent)" stroke-width="2" />

                        <!-- Right Eye Socket -->
